body:
From your note: a better steel windmill (ladder, platform, thicker wheel) and a second version, "Old and creaky, alone on the field" (wooden, leaning, blades missing). Switch between them on the card.
Picked in Model Compare.
short: Picked: Farm windmill: better + old creaky version

title: Farm windmill: better + old creaky version
